question: Should OpenClaw bundle Vault as an in-repo plugin whose exec resolver receives Vault auth material and performs Vault network reads, or keep Vault as an external/ClawHub plugin on the existing SecretRef integration seam?
rationale: The code uses the existing SecretRef integration seam, but the bundled distribution and credential/network trust boundary are product and security choices that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Accept bundled Vault after cleanup
options.body: Fix the docs map and plugin-boundary blockers, require current-head dependency/secops approval, and land the bundled plugin with the current SecretRef integration design.

options.title: Keep Vault external
options.body: Route the Vault implementation to ClawHub or another external plugin package while keeping the existing plugin-managed SecretRef seam as the supported extension point.

options.title: Narrow to seam guidance
options.body: Ask for a smaller follow-up that documents how external Vault plugins should use the merged integration contract without adding bundled resolver code.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Vault after cleanup
recommendation.body: Fix the docs map and plugin-boundary blockers, require current-head dependency/secops approval, and land the bundled plugin with the current SecretRef integration design.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is primarily a protected security/dependency boundary decision, and the PR timeline already routes that review to steipete.
